facts.text: I want a story set on an island with characters Shadow, Loki, and Ashton as antagonists.
I want a story set on an island with characters Toast, Sofie, Lolydyno, and Artemis as protagonists.
I want a character named Aiyden added with similar lore to Percy Jackson.
I want Aiden also made an antagonist.
I want a detailed 1000-word battle story involving Aiyden and Shadow versus Toast and Sofie.
I want a precursor explaining why Aiyden and Shadow hate Toast and Sofie.
I want Aiyden on Shadow's side.
I want the characters to fight Sofie and Toast.
I want a character named Shadow who is an immortal trying to figure out a way to be mortal once more.
I want Shadow to have become immortal after killing his brother.
I want Shadow to have been granted immortality by a god to remember his sin.
I want a character named Loki included in the story.
I want a character named Ashton who was forced into the Human realm away from the gods.
I want Ashton to have mortal strength and qualities.
I want Ashton to remember only fragments of his past.
I want Ashton to be on a journey to find out who he was no matter the cost.
I want a character named Toast who is a sheltered witch native to the Mushroom Isle.
I want Toast to have not had much contact with the outside world.
I want Toast to not really understand the world outside of the Isle.
I want a character named Sofie who is a village girl curious about the isles that lie next door.
I want Sofie to be curious despite warnings about witches.
I want a character named Lolydyno who comes from a line of dragon tamers.
I want Lolydyno to have grown up in Calvaria all her life.
I want Lolydyno to be on a mission to find the last dragon.
I want a character named Artemis who is a descendant of the mighty sorcerer.
I want Artemis to have studied magic for years.
I want Artemis to use their knowledge to help others.
I want a character named Dogo who was born in Lagoville.
I want Dogo to have grown up with simple origins working on a farm day in and day out.
I want Dogo's family to have drowned.
I want Dogo to have kept up the legacy of farming after their family drowned.
I want Dogo to be sick of the lifestyle and want to explore the world beneath them.
I want a character named world who comes from a long line of Buddhists.
I want world to decide to go on an adventure off where they are not getting enough of a challenge.
I want world to hope to find a worthy opponent.
I want world to be dumb as heck without their "Talon Powder".

keyphrases: Aiyden and Shadow vs Toast and Sofie

events.text: Create a story with Shadow, Loki, and Ashton as antagonists and Toast, Sofie, Lolydyno, and Artemis as protagonists on an island.
Add Aiyden with similar lore to Percy Jackson.
Write a 1000-word detailed battle story of Aiyden and Shadow vs Toast and Sofie, including a precursor for why they hate each other.
Make Aiyden on Shadow's side and have them fight Sofie and Toast.
